evals.name: vague-url-data-cloud
evals.prompt: scrape any endpoint from Data Cloud and save the JSON under /tmp/dsc-eval-out. Pick one yourself.
evals.expected_output: Agent navigates the DSC API catalog page at https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/apis#browse to find Data Cloud (possibly rebranded to Data 360), follows a /references/ link, handles the Summary redirect if it hits one, picks a verb-shaped slug, and writes a JSON file with kind=endpoint. Does not guess URLs by analogy.
expectations: Agent visited the DSC API catalog page (https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/apis#browse) before committing to a reference URL
At least one .json file was written under the outputs directory
Some written file has "kind": "endpoint" (not only a Summary)
The final endpoint belongs to a Data Cloud / Data 360 reference (reference id or title mentions data / data-360 / cdp / einstein-studio)
Agent did not invoke the scraper with a hallucinated URL that returned an error without recovery

evals.name: summary-redirect-then-endpoint
evals.prompt: scrape https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/commerce-api/references/shopper-products and save to /tmp/dsc-eval-out. then get me one of the actual endpoints from it.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes the bare /references/<name> URL triggers whole-reference mode, scrapes it (writing Summary.json + _index.json + every endpoint + types/), then identifies a verb-shaped slug from _index.json as 'the endpoint' to report back. Does NOT present Summary.json as an endpoint, and does NOT re-invoke the scraper for a single endpoint that was already written.
expectations: Summary.json was written for the shopper-products reference
_index.json was written and its slugs field is a non-empty array
A verb-shaped endpoint slug file exists with "kind": "endpoint" (slug begins with get/create/update/delete/search/list or is otherwise a product operation)
Agent did not present Summary.json content as the endpoint answer to the user
Agent ran the scraper exactly once for this reference (whole-reference mode already wrote the endpoint to disk)

evals.name: atlas-scope-decline
evals.prompt: scrape the Salesforce Platform REST API guide for me, save to /tmp/dsc-eval-out. the URL is https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_rest.meta/api_rest/intro_what_is_rest_api.htm
evals.expected_output: Agent declines: recognizes the atlas.*.htm URL shape is out of scope, lets the classifier emit its decline message, and explains the skill can't scrape atlas books (different viewer, no RAML/OAS custom elements). Does NOT try to WebFetch the page as a workaround.
expectations: Scraper was invoked with the atlas URL and exited non-zero with a decline-style message
Agent's final message to the user declined the request and cited the atlas / different-viewer / no-/references/ reason
Agent did not attempt to fetch or scrape the atlas URL via any alternate mechanism (WebFetch, curl, etc.)
Agent did not invent or guess an alternate DSC URL as a substitute without verifying it first
